## Description

Provide a clear and concise description of your changes.

## Review Preference

Choose one:

- [ ] I have time to handle formatting and style feedback myself.
- [ ] The docs team handles formatting (check **Allow edits from maintainers**).

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes build and render correctly locally (`make build`).
- [ ] [Documentation Style Guide](https://github.com/paritytech/documentation-style-guide) followed.
- [ ] Content covers Parity tools, SDKs, or libraries. Ecosystem-wide Polkadot content belongs in the [Polkadot Developer Docs](https://github.com/Polkadot-Community-Foundation/polkadot-docs).
